verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents pipeline processing that runs unattended in the background. Functions transform events automatically before delivery, connector syncs run as Kubernetes CronJobs (a recurring schedule), a reprocessing worker replays dead-lettered events, and alerts fire when syncs or batches fail. These are automations inside a data pipeline rather than general user-defined background automations, and the schedule configuration itself is not documented. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable schedules or triggers for syncs and jobs, general-purpose autonomous automation beyond event processing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
